input.rationale: Section 12(b) gives only a breach-of-contract indemnity from TrueLink (no duty to defend, no IP infringement, breach of law, data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct cover, and no defence procedure), while Section 12(a) imposes a very broad Client indemnity covering Client's breach of the Agreement, System/Credit Repository Agreement defaults, Web Site claims generally and product/service injury. That fails the fallback (no Vendor IP indemnity anywhere in the document) and approaches walk-away territory. We added a TrueLink defence and indemnity for third-party IP, breach of applicable law, TrueLink-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with notice, control and cooperation, and limited our indemnity to Client Content and Client's violations of law by removing the breach-of-Agreement, System Agreement default, Web Site and product-injury prongs. We did not add the fallback 3× super-cap or procure/modify/replace/refund mechanic, which belong to the fallback level and would newly limit TrueLink's exposure.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink IP/misconduct indemnity with defence procedure and limit Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's violations of law.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently reaches only its own breach of this Agreement, so we added a defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, TrueLink's breach of applicable law, TrueLink-caused data breach and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure. We also limited our indemnity to Client Content and Client's violations of law, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.text: TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, Hosting Services or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law, (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink, or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Client shall promptly notify TrueLink of any such claim, TrueLink shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and Client shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) any claim arising out of or relating to Client Content, and (ii) any violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation by Client.
